I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I said I'd treat the 8 April Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date as unverified, because nothing she can see backs it up.

I only checked what Pree herself can see. The shared files have nothing on Brackenwater: there are no account or contract files for it, and neither Central team digest mentions it. #central-team has never mentioned Brackenwater before her message.

I suggested treating 8 April as a lead until the account owner checks it against the contract or the customer confirms it in writing. I didn't send any mail and didn't need any approvals.
